☕ Late Breakfast at the Hotel
Food
Hotel dinner and breakfast are included at Globales Panama — use them. Save money on Friday and Saturday evenings by eating at the hotel before going out. Breakfast in the morning helps recovery massively. Only eat out when the hotel dining doesn't fit your timing.

OPTION A
🏰 Palma City Culture Run
Sightseeing
Uber to Palma (€12 each way split 4 = €3pp). Hit Castillo de Bellver first — circular medieval castle, €4 entry, panoramic views over the entire Bay of Palma. Genuinely one of the best viewpoints in Mallorca. Then head down to La Seu Cathedral right on the sea wall — Gothic interior, massive rose windows, pre-book tickets online for ~€10. Total time: 2.5 hours. Great pics throughout.
📍 Palma City🚕 Split Uber ~€3pp each way💰 €4 castle + €10 cathedral

Rules of Engagement

Dos & Don'ts

✅ Do
💰
Stick to the €200/day cap. Track what you're spending on nights out — drinks go fast. If you're blowing out on Friday, dial back Saturday afternoon.
🛒
Buy drinks from Mercadona before the beach and pre-drinking at the hotel. €1.50 beers vs €7 beach bar beers. Across 3 days this saves €20–30 each.
🚕
Always split Ubers between all four of you. A €24 Uber becomes €6pp. Factor this in — don't take solo taxis unless you need to.
📱
Pre-book the activity you want to do. Jet skis and watersports sell out in June. Same for Madame Cabra on Saturday evening. Book the night before at least.
🎶
DM Times Square and Pure Night Club before you fly. Confirm the afrobeats/amapiano DJ set is on for your specific night. Themes can vary by date.
⏰
MC + TT — know your exact flight time and work backwards. Palma Airport is 25–30 min from Magaluf. Leave with 2.5 hours before departure. No exceptions.
🌞
Use SPF every single day. June Mallorca will burn you in under an hour near water. Reapply every 90 mins. Getting burnt on Day 1 ruins the whole trip.
💧
Drink water on nights out. Hot country, hot clubs, lots of alcohol. One glass of water between drinks. Heat dehydration on a budget trip = wasted day recovering.
❌ Don't
🚫
Don't buy drinks from street touts on Punta Ballena. "2 shots and 2 drinks for €10" offers from reps outside clubs are watered down or you'll get hit with extra charges inside. Go straight to the bar.
🚫
Don't take your passport or extra cards to clubs. Hotel safe everything valuable. Take one bank card, your phone, and cash for the night only.
🚫
Don't get into a taxi without agreeing the price first. Use Uber where possible — it's widely available in Mallorca and the price is fixed. Non-metered taxis can overcharge tourists.
🚫
Don't pre-drink too hard before Pure Night Club. Doors open 11:30pm, peak time is 1–4am. You need to still be going at 3am. Pace Friday and Saturday pre-drinks.
🚫
Don't underestimate how far the strip is from the hotel. Punta Ballena Magaluf is 20 min walk or a €5 Uber. Don't decide to walk back at 4am after a night out.
🚫
Don't skip breakfast on big nights. You need to eat before going out. A proper dinner lines your stomach and means you spend less on drinks to feel the same effect.
🚫
Don't get involved in any trouble. Magaluf in June is rowdy. Walk away from anything brewing. A police situation in Spain will ruin the whole trip and cost far more than the budget.
🚫
Don't leave Sunday dinner booking to Sunday. Decent restaurants near Palma Nova fill up Saturday evening for Sunday. Book Saturday night at the latest.
